stateWithholding.regularPayrollFormula: Subtract the payroll-period share of annual MI-W4 personal and dependency exemptions from compensation, do not reduce below zero, then multiply by 4.25%.
stateWithholding.separatelyPaidBonusFormula: Multiply the entire separately paid bonus or other supplemental compensation by 4.25% without an exemption adjustment.
stateWithholding.invalidOrMissingMiW4: Use a prior valid MI-W4 if one remains effective; otherwise withhold from total compensation using zero exemptions.
residencyAndWorkRules: Withhold Michigan tax for employees working in Michigan unless a reciprocal-state exemption applies.
A Michigan employer assigning a Michigan resident temporarily outside Michigan continues Michigan withholding.
A reciprocal-state resident working in Michigan is exempt when supported by the employer's retained nonresidency certification.

otherBranches.taxablePensionAndRetirement: Apply 4.25% after the MI-W4P exemption allowance; without MI-W4P apply 4.25% to the entire taxable distribution.

localSelectionModel.form: DW-4 / Form 5527 or the corresponding locally administered city certificate
requiredCapabilities: Percent of compensation earned in each work city
Resident credit interaction between taxing cities
localSelectionModel.predominantWorkCityRule: For Detroit nonresidents, the taxable work city must represent the greatest percentage earned among Michigan taxing cities other than the residence city and must be at least 25%.

localJurisdictions.name: Detroit
localJurisdictions.residentApplicability: All compensation regardless of work location.
localJurisdictions.nonresidentApplicability: Detroit-allocated compensation only, and only when Detroit is the predominant place of employment.
localJurisdictions.missingCertificateRule: Apply resident rate to all compensation with zero exemptions.
localJurisdictions.supplementalRule: Apply the applicable resident or nonresident rate without exemptions.
localJurisdictions.residentOtherTaxingCityCreditFormula: Detroit resident withholding rate equals 2.4% minus the other work city's nonresident rate; withhold separately for both cities.

captureWarnings: The State of Michigan identifies 24 taxing cities but administers only Detroit during 2026; each of the other 23 cities requires its own current official rate, form, filing, and boundary capture.
Flint administration transfers to the Michigan Department of Treasury on January 1, 2027 for 2026 and future tax-year returns; this does not make Treasury the 2026 payroll withholding administrator.
The two raw PDFs were downloaded manually after direct retrieval returned HTTP 403 and are now checksummed.

review.requiredNextStep: Capture current official publications for the remaining 23 cities, verify state and Detroit rounding, implement multi-city allocation and resident credits, and add executable tests before activation.
